checks.describe: cilium-networking cluster is up with Cilium as CNI (no kube-proxy)
backend (2 replicas) and frontend (1 replica) pods are Running in m7-lab namespace
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n m7-lab get pods --no-headers --field-selector=status.phase=Running | wc -l | tr -d ' \n'

checks.describe: Cilium has assigned security identities to m7-lab pods (identity-based policy enforcement)
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n m7-lab get ciliumendpoints --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' \n'

checks.describe: default-deny-ingress NetworkPolicy is applied in m7-lab
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n m7-lab get networkpolicy default-deny-ingress -o jsonpath='{.spec.policyTypes[0]}'

checks.describe: allow-frontend-to-backend NetworkPolicy permits frontend → backend on port 80
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n m7-lab get networkpolicy allow-frontend-to-backend -o jsonpath='{.spec.ingress[0].ports[0].port}'

checks.describe: frontend can reach backend on port 80 (policy whitelist working)
checks.run: FRONTEND=$(kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n m7-lab get pod -l app=frontend -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n m7-lab exec $FRONTEND -- curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 5 http://backend
